# rstar 0.12.2 license supplement

The crates.io archive for rstar 0.12.2 declares `MIT OR Apache-2.0` but omits
the license texts. These unmodified files come from the repository root at
commit `c8c5bf9e41468281d030869d409e3f67f1aaf5b7`, the commit recorded in that
archive's `.cargo_vcs_info.json` (package path `rstar`). Retrieved 2026-10-17.

| File | Upstream | SHA256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LICENSE-MIT | https://github.com/georust/rstar/blob/c8c5bf9e41468281d030869d409e3f67f1aaf5b7/LICENSE-MIT | `9b3a76c27bac8f3e0ff2d1f64f65941c50310ae3ff69318cea230bd4a36822c5` |
| LICENSE-APACHE | https://github.com/georust/rstar/blob/c8c5bf9e41468281d030869d409e3f67f1aaf5b7/LICENSE-APACHE | `a60eea817514531668d7e00765731449fe14d059d3249e0bc93b36de45f759f2` |

`tools/package_cli.py` uses this supplement only for that exact package version.
Review it again when updating the dependency. These texts retain their upstream terms.
